title: Deepfake Principal Clip
scenario: A clip shows the principal announcing a school closure, but no official notice exists.

answers.A: Ask a trusted adult or school staff through a known channel.
answers.B: Click the link or follow the instruction quickly so you do not miss out.
answers.C: Report/block it and do not share private details.
answers.D: Ask the sender in the same chat to prove it is real.

explanation: Deepfake Principal Clip: the trap is to make borrowed authority feel safer than checking. The safer move is to ask a trusted adult or school staff, not to act before verifying.
proTip: Video alone is not proof; school notices must come from official channels.
